```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(mt.surv)
```

# Get data (n = 403 samples)

```{r}
# scores
scores <- read.csv("../data/tho_lung_cancer-mitoBuffa-TPM.csv")

# clinical info 
pt.key <- read_delim("../data/tho_lung_cancer.s_clinical_data.tsv", delim = "\t", quote = "", col_names = TRUE) %>%
  separate(`Sample ID`, into = c("Pt.id", "sample", "WES.ID"), sep = "_", fill = "right") %>%
  mutate(WES.ID = ifelse(`Sequencing Type` == "WES", sample, WES.ID),
         sample = ifelse(`Sequencing Type` == "WES", NA, sample),
         sample = gsub("-RNA", "", sample)) %>%
  filter(sample %in% scores$sample) %>%
  # get vars of interest 
  select(sample, AgeAtDiagnosis, AgeAtLastContact, PatientVitalStatus, RadiationTherapyInd, ImmunoOncologyDrug) %>%
  full_join(scores)
```
# Create surv var

```{r}
survin <- pt.key %>%
  mutate(days = (365.25*as.double(AgeAtLastContact))-(365.25*as.double(AgeAtDiagnosis)),
         vitalstatus = ifelse(PatientVitalStatus == "Dead", 1, 0)) %>%
   select(sample, days, vitalstatus)

# join with var of interest 
```

# mt.surv

Note - function requires same order of samples 

```{r}
res <- mt.surv::survivalByQuantile()
```




```{r}
#here is the 'drop the middle' code

test.quants <- seq(0.01, 0.5, by = 0.01)

tmp.out <- data.frame(i = test.quants,
                      hr = NA,
                      p.value = NA,
                      cutoff.value = NA)
i <- 1

for (i in 1:length(test.quants)) {
  
  lower.threshold <- test.quants[i]
  upper.threshold <- 1 - test.quants[i] 
  
  tmp <- 
    CApos %>% 
    mutate(new.groups = case_when(CandidaCount < quantile(CandidaCount, probs = lower.threshold) ~ "Low",
                                  CandidaCount > quantile(CandidaCount, probs = upper.threshold) ~ "High"))
  
  tmp.cand <- tmp %>% 
    select(AvatarKey, CandidaCount)
  
  survivaldfshort <- survivaldf %>% 
    right_join(tmp.cand, by = "AvatarKey") %>% 
    select(AvatarKey, diagsurvtime, vitalstatus, days)
    
  survoutput <-  mt.surv::survivalByQuantile("CandidaCount", tmp.cand, survivaldfshort)
  #need a left join and a select
  
  arranged.survoutput <- survoutput %>% 
  arrange(pval) 
  
  tmp.out$p.value[i] <- arranged.survoutput$pval[1]
  tmp.out$hr[i] <- arranged.survoutput$hazard.ratio[1]
  tmp.out$cutoff.value[i] <- arranged.survoutput$cutoff.value[1]
  
}

```
